rows.notes: asyncio.gather over comma-split symbols; per symbol GET /etfs/{sym}/stats then a second GET /etfs/{sym}/analytics whose keys are update()-merged into the same single row; keys containing the adjustment/return_type substrings are popped client-side; ETF_PERFORMANCE_MAP renames plus __alias_dict__; result rows re-sorted to caller symbol order.

URL branch: /etfs?exchange= vs /etfs/search?query= vs plain /etfs (2 distinct paths); rows under 'etfs' key; next_page while-loop in the response callback continues a server page token after the initial page_size=10000 request; transform_data applies case-insensitive regex contains filter on name. UNMAPPED_SUGGESTION: cursor_next_page_pagination —— body_offset_pagination 是 offset 语义，这里是服务端 next_page 游标续传。

Two-hop: GET /companies/{sym}/fundamentals?statement_code=calculations&type=... then fan out GET /fundamentals/{id}/standardized_financials for the first `limit` ids taken from hop 1; each response's tagged list is assembled into one per-period row keyed by data_tag.tag against a ~90-tag allowlist; zero/falsy values nulled; period mapping quarter->QTR/annual->FY/ttm/ytd.

Same zacks-consensus family as EPS/sales but its own module and endpoint /zacks/ebitda_consensus; rows under 'ebitda_consensus'; identifier= per symbol via gather, estimate_type aliased to type; no-symbol branch loops next_page; transform drops rows lacking estimate_count/updated_date, maps fiscal_period annual->fy else fq client-side, sorts by fiscal_year+last_updated desc. UNMAPPED_SUGGESTION: cursor_next_page_pagination —— 现有键只有 offset 语义分页。

Endpoint /zacks/eps_estimates; rows under 'estimates'; differs from sales twin only in field set (mean_1w..3m as *_days_ago aliases, single revisions_change_percent /100 validator); per-item company object popped and flattened into symbol/name; fiscal_period/calendar_period uppercase match dropped client-side; no-symbol branch paginates via next_page while-loop. UNMAPPED_SUGGESTION: cursor_next_page_pagination —— 现有键无游标分页语义。

Not the pagination pattern of the eps/sales/ebitda family: symbol branch fans out GET /zacks/forward_pe/{symbol} (one flat dict per symbol appended directly); no-symbol branch does a single GET /zacks/forward_pe?page_size=10000 reading 'forward_pe' key with no next_page loop; UnauthorizedError/OpenBBError re-raised per gathered symbol; ticker/company_name/forward_pe_year1-5 aliases.

Mirror of the EPS module against /zacks/sales_estimates; rows under 'estimates'; what differs per row: estimated_sales_mean alias and three revisions up/down/percent triplets (1w/1m/3m) with a three-field /100 percent validator; same company-object flatten, same client-side period drop, same no-symbol next_page loop; defaults calendar_year=now when no symbol/year. UNMAPPED_SUGGESTION: cursor_next_page_pagination —— 现有键无游标分页语义。

Single URL /indices/economic/${symbol}/historical_data/level via amake_requests([url]); leading '$' stripped from symbol; rows under 'historical_data'; pagination is opt-in via all_pages flag with next_page re-query and asyncio.sleep rate-limit when page_size>100; transform_query defaults a 1-year start/end window; limit aliased to page_size. UNMAPPED_SUGGESTION: cursor_next_page_pagination —— 现有键无游标分页语义。

Own module, not shared with the forward-estimates family despite the sibling pattern: Cartesian fan-out of /historical_data/{symbol}/{tag} urls (symbol×tag both multi-item) through amake_requests; each row gets symbol and tag columns derived from response.url path parts; per-url next_page while-loop; aliases sort->sort_order, limit->page_size, tag_type->type; rows under 'historical_data'; error/message downgraded to warning and empty list. UNMAPPED_SUGGESTION: cursor_next_page_pagination —— 现有键无游标分页语义。

Single GET /securities/{symbol}/prices/adjustments, rows under 'stock_price_adjustments' (:95); no pagination loop. field_rename_map comes from the alias dict at :36-40 (date->ex_dividend_date, dividend->amount, dividend_currency->currency) restated as ColumnSpec.source_key; param_value_mapping from limit->page_size with default 100 at :25-30 as ParamSpec.query_key; derived_columns from the per-row stamping of the queried symbol at :102-104, now carried by ModelSpec.column_derives (DerivePlan source_kind=parameter). transform_query's 1-year relative default window (historical_dividends.py:74-78) fills a bound from today when the caller names none, while ParamSpec.default holds a literal, so the row needs relative_date_default (param.relative_default, absent): with an omitted bound this declaration sends no window and answers wider than upstream. That is the blocker and why the flag is false; the other three labels are each carried in specs.py and proven offline, so the row is one capability from ready, not three. tests/test_intrinio_engine_provider.py::TestHistoricalDividends proves symbol-stamped, renamed rows come out offline.

Per-symbol gather on GET /historical_data/{symbol}/marketcap; interval adds frequency={interval}ly only when not day (day sends no frequency param); fixed page_size=10000 with no next_page loop; rows under 'historical_data' with falsy value items dropped; unknown identifier error string 'Cannot look up this item/identifier combination' swallowed into warnings per symbol; start_date defaults to 2007-01-01; market_cap<-value alias.

Same two-hop fundamentals skeleton as FinancialRatios but statement_code=income_statement and a third in-callback hop: hop1 /companies/{sym}/fundamentals yields fiscal_year-fiscal_period keys, hop2 GET /fundamentals/{sym}-income_statement-{period}/standardized_financials, and inside each callback the id is rewritten to calculations to session.get_json a calculations standard-financials call whose 5 margin tags (ebit/ebitda/ebitdamargin/pretaxincomemargin/grossmargin) are appended to the same row; 3-letter data_tag unit becomes reported_currency; period id built client-side (annual->FY etc).

amake_requests over per-symbol GET /indices/stock_market/${symbol}/historical_data/level (symbol cleaned of $/^ then re-prefixed with $); rows under 'historical_data' with null values dropped; symbol column taken from the response's nested 'index'.symbol and only prepended when multiple symbols requested; close<-value alias, limit->page_size (default 10000, no next_page loop), sort->sort_order; 1-year default window in transform_query.
